method: Run from the worktree root in this order. First, candidate: the committed IB-pr-595 transplant files for 49financial (holdings_snapshot.py and publication.py, checked against the sha256 values IB-pr-595's record names) were written into a detached worktree of the minting pin outside the repository (sparse checkout disabled there); the diff of commit 0a745b842b for holdings_snapshot.py (the three ABSENT-AT-SOURCE-D spans) was applied to the transplanted file with git apply after git apply --check; the result was verified by stripping every D span and comparing the rest with the transplant byte for byte, comparing the D spans with HEAD's, and testing for the one-date bypass and the CUSIP key; the two candidate files were written under deliverables/addendum/49financial/. Second, firm: the candidate bundle was built twice by the minting pin's safe_deploy_core build_bundle_payload (BUILD ONLY, no upload function called), the live bundle was read with s3api head-object and get-object (read only) and compared member by member with the candidate, and six offline test files were copied from HEAD and run with pytest on the candidate tree (the one-date bypass test was not run). Third, assemble wrote the record. Nothing was uploaded, minted, deployed, signed or written to AWS.
notes: Facts and their basis: the transplant files are IB-pr-595's committed 49financial files, checked against the sha256 values in its record before use; the D spans are commit 0a745b842b's three insertions, applied by git apply after a clean git apply --check (3 hunks, 0 conflicts).

Measured here: 3 D spans in the candidate equal HEAD's three spans text for text; stripping them leaves the signed transplant byte for byte; 0 lines differ outside the spans; the one-date bypass is absent and cusip_key is present.

Not read and not run: no upload, mint, publish, deploy, sign-in or vendor call was made; the live bundle was read only with head-object and get-object; test_holdings_bypass_one_date.py was not run because it tests the bypass that is not shipped. Sparse directories: data/assets/scripts/gold/investor_reporting/ was added to the base worktree (local, never committed); the pin is a full checkout outside the repository.

Pin tree state: the minting pin's index had 36 entries whose line endings differ from its .gitattributes eol=lf rule, so git status lists them before any change; they are not bundle changes and the status comparison in this run was taken against that baseline, adding only the two candidate files.
